title: Director-General
description: Definition of Director-General under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: the Director-General appointed under sub-section (2) of section 15
content.plain_language: the main official in charge, appointed according to section 15, sub-section 2
examples: The Director-General oversees the consumer protection agency.
The Director-General is responsible for enforcing consumer rights.
non_examples: A company's CEO is not necessarily a Director-General.
A local consumer advocate is not a Director-General.

user_queries: Who is the Director-General under the Consumer Protection Act?
